title: How to Remove Video Subtitles with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This guide turns the recorded workflow into a clean, publish-ready tutorial: Codex uploads a local video, calls Medux through MCP, waits for processing, and saves a subtitle-free MP4 back into the workspace.
